searchText: Is someone interested in reviewing pairing precompile for BN254 curve? https://github.com/ethereum/evmone/pull/852 does an implementation of ecmul for bls (whether g1/g2) using GLV require a subgroup check? obviously the precompiles are specced to require subgroup checks. But does the GLV optimization require it? multipairing can also benefit from multithreading the discount being too steep matches my own benches, however BLST does implement the bucket algorithm and should be sublinear. It is. But see the report https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/800773302213279784/1291492438678044694.
